name: driver_entry_init
desc: Driver jump table entry: initialize Sound Blaster driver
details: Entry point 1 in the driver dispatch table at offset 0005h. Performs a far jump to sb_driver_init (0823:1071), which initializes the Sound Blaster hardware, configures DMA/IRQ from the BLASTER environment variable, sets up double buffers, and hooks INT 0xF3.

0823:0005.comment: Jump to Sound Blaster driver initialization routine
